intro.label: Introduction
intro.heading: Innovative strategies for sustainable and high-performance growth.
intro.p1: Marabu supports businesses, institutions and organisations in their strategic, operational and relational challenges. Our approach combines African wisdom with modern strategic action, delivering tailor-made, lasting, high-impact solutions.
intro.p2: Specialised in strategic consulting, operational services and institutional intermediation, we operate where decisions are made — with governments, technical and financial partners, and the private actors shaping the continent.
intro.p3: Founded in 2023 and based in Abidjan, Marabu is the partner of those who want to build with method, influence with integrity and grow with vision.

who.label: Who we are
who.heading: A centuries-old heritage reinvented into modern strategic action.
who.p1: For centuries, African marabouts guided communities with wisdom and foresight. Advisors, mediators and guardians of knowledge, they embodied an enlightened authority capable of turning challenges into opportunities.
who.p2: Founded in 2023, Marabu reinvents this heritage. A strategic actor in consulting, services and intermediation, we combine tradition and technology to support our partners in an ever-changing world.

founder.label: Founder's note
founder.heading: Why Marabu?
founder.quote1: "I grew up with the idea that the marabouts of our villages were the first strategists — those entrusted with difficult decisions, delicate mediations, future projects. They acted with discernment, network and trust."
founder.quote2: "Marabu is the contemporary translation of this posture. We bring to businesses and institutions what these wise men brought to communities: clarity, connections and direction."

name.label: The name's meaning
name.heading: A sage. A guide. A bridge between two worlds.
name.p1: In African traditions, the marabout is far more than an advisor. He is the guardian of knowledge, the mediator of conflicts, the guide of communities facing decisions that shape the future. His authority does not come from his title — it comes from the trust he has earned.
name.p2: We are the heirs of this posture. Marabu translates this ancestral wisdom into contemporary strategic action: accompanying, guiding, connecting — with the same demand for integrity and clarity.

mvp.label: Mission
mvp.text: To embody excellence and innovation through concrete and strategic solutions. To support businesses and institutions in their ambitions for growth, digitalisation and sustainable performance.

mvp.label: Vision
mvp.text: To build bridges between local needs and global opportunities. To be the transformation catalyst that places people, innovation and long-term vision at the heart of every mission.

mvp.label: Values
mvp.text: Inspired innovation, positive impact and client commitment: three principles that guide each of our missions.

promise.label: Our promise
promise.text: Tailor-made, high-value answers. With agility, boldness and impact — we shape success trajectories together.

items.title: Inspired Innovation
items.desc: Uniting traditions with modern technologies. We draw on African wisdom to design solutions rooted in the present and oriented towards the future.

items.title: Positive Impact
items.desc: Contributing to sustainable and inclusive development. Each mission is assessed on its real value to the organisations and communities they serve.

items.title: Client Commitment
items.desc: Providing personalised solutions to your needs. We do not sell generic formulas — we build tailor-made answers, with you.

impact.label: Social Impact
impact.desc: Every mandate we accept is a responsibility. We measure our success by the real impact generated for our clients and the communities they serve.

servicesPage.subtitle: Strategic consulting, operational services, intermediation — Marabu steps in where rigour, connections and vision make the difference.

services.name: Consulting
services.intro: We support leaders and institutions in their most complex strategic decisions. Our approach combines analytical rigour with knowledge of the African terrain.

offerings.title: Business strategy
offerings.desc: Setting direction, competitive positioning, medium and long-term development plans. We help organisations clarify their vision and build realistic trajectories.

details.intro: We help leaders make the call: which market to enter, with which resources, on what timeline. The work starts from your actual data — figures, competition, regulatory constraints — and ends with a direction you can defend before a board or an investor.
includes: Strategic diagnosis: market, competition, internal strengths and weaknesses
Positioning and growth priorities
Business plan and 3–5 year financial modelling
Portfolio arbitration and investment scenarios
Translation of the strategy into annual targets and tracking indicators
deliverables: Strategic framing note and board-ready summary
Costed 3–5 year development plan
Operational roadmap and indicator dashboard
details.audience: Executive teams, shareholders and boards of companies that are growing or repositioning.

offerings.title: Organisational transformation
offerings.desc: Change management, optimisation of structures and processes. Marabu accompanies deep transformations with method and care for teams.

details.intro: An organisation that has grown fast eventually collides with its own processes. We rebuild the structure, the roles and the decision paths, then support the rollout until the new rules hold without us.
includes: Organisational audit: structure, roles, decision paths
Mapping and optimisation of key processes
Structural redesign and team sizing
Governance bodies and management routines
Support for managers throughout the transition
deliverables: Organisational audit report with prioritised recommendations
Target organisation chart, role descriptions and responsibility matrix
Sequenced transformation plan with milestones and indicators
details.audience: Fast-growing companies and institutions, groups merging operations, or organisations losing operational efficiency.

offerings.title: Governance & compliance
offerings.desc: Design of governance frameworks adapted to regulatory requirements and institutional challenges of the sub-region.

details.intro: Regulators, donors and investors are raising their requirements across the sub-region. We build governance frameworks that meet those expectations without paralysing day-to-day decisions.
includes: Governance diagnosis and review of existing bodies
Charters, internal rules and delegations of authority
Compliance frameworks: internal control, risk management, anti-money laundering
Preparation for regulator, donor and investor audits
Training for directors and specialised committees
deliverables: Risk map and remediation plan
Governance documentation: charters, procedures, delegations
Compliance calendar and reporting framework
details.audience: Financial institutions, state-owned enterprises, private groups and organisations answering to a regulator or to donors.

offerings.title: Change management
offerings.desc: Human and cultural change leadership. Training of executive teams, managing resistance, lasting accompaniment through transformation.

details.intro: A reorganisation rarely fails on paper — it fails in the corridors. We work on what actually blocks it: team buy-in, internal politics, and managers' ability to carry the message.
includes: Stakeholder analysis and mapping of resistance
Internal communication plan and listening mechanisms
Training and coaching for leadership teams and internal champions
Adoption workshops and on-the-ground support
Buy-in measurement and adjustment of the approach
deliverables: Stakeholder map and support plan
Internal communication kit and manager talking points
Adoption review and consolidation recommendations
details.audience: Organisations going through a merger, a restructuring, a new system or a shift in management culture.

services.name: Services
services.intro: Operational frameworks to strengthen your teams, amplify your image and deliver tangible results. Marabu works with you, not in your place.

offerings.title: Professional training
offerings.desc: Tailored modules: e-reputation, crisis communication, leadership, project management. Delivered by experts, in person or online.

details.intro: Our training starts from your real situations, not textbook cases. Every module is built to measure, led by practitioners, and ends with tools your teams use the next day.
includes: Tailor-made modules built from a needs assessment
Online reputation, crisis communication, leadership, project management
Delivery on site, remotely or in blended format
Role-plays and case studies drawn from your sector
Assessment of learning and post-training follow-up
deliverables: Tailored curriculum and training materials
Toolkit and practical sheets for participants
Evaluation report and follow-up recommendations
details.audience: Leadership teams, middle managers, communication and human resources departments.

offerings.title: Institutional communication
offerings.desc: Editorial strategy, brand image management, press relations. We build coherent and lasting narratives for your institutions.

details.intro: An institution that does not tell its own story leaves others to tell it. We build a coherent narrative that holds over time, and the means to carry it to your audiences.
includes: Image audit and analysis of how your audiences perceive you
Brand platform and editorial line
Annual communication plan and speaking calendar
Press relations: targeting, media kits, spokesperson support
Handling of sensitive situations and crisis communication
deliverables: Image diagnosis and brand platform
Communication plan and editorial calendar
Press kit, talking points and crisis procedure
details.audience: Public institutions, companies, NGOs and international organisations exposed to media scrutiny.

offerings.title: Strategic events
offerings.desc: Design, organisation and coordination of high-impact events: inaugurations, summits, institutional ceremonies, forums.

details.intro: A summit, an inauguration or an official ceremony is judged on details: protocol, logistics, media coverage. We take on the whole chain, from concept to debrief.
includes: Format, storyline and protocol design
Logistics coordination: venues, suppliers, security, accreditation
Management of invitations and official delegations
Media coverage and on-site content production
Budget control and post-event review
deliverables: Concept note and detailed staging plan
Reverse schedule, budget and logistics plan
Press kit and costed post-event review
details.audience: Ministries, institutions, companies and international organisations running high-visibility events.

offerings.title: Content creation
offerings.desc: Production of high added-value content: reports, advocacy pieces, institutional publications, training materials.

details.intro: An annual report, an advocacy paper or a position note only matters if it gets read. We produce content that is rigorous in substance and readable in form, fit for donors and general audiences alike.
includes: Annual reports, activity reports and institutional publications
Position papers, advocacy documents and argument briefs
Training materials and methodological guides
Desk research, interviews and data verification
Art direction, layout and digital versions
deliverables: Written, sourced and validated content
Laid-out documents, ready to print and to publish online
Short versions for social media and press relations
details.audience: Institutions, NGOs, donors and companies that need to produce reference documents.

services.name: Intermediation
services.intro: Marabu acts behind the scenes with discretion and method. We open the doors that matter — in governmental, diplomatic and financial circles.

offerings.title: Government relations
offerings.desc: Strategic interface with public decision-makers, ministries and regulatory institutions. Facilitation of high-sensitivity dialogues.

details.intro: Reaching the right public counterpart, at the right moment, with the right file — that is where most blockages are decided. We prepare those conversations and support them, within the rules and in full transparency.
includes: Mapping of public decision-makers and decision paths
Preparation of files and technical arguments
Setting up and attending institutional meetings
Follow-up on administrative and regulatory procedures
Monitoring of reforms and draft legislation
deliverables: Stakeholder map and institutional context note
Presentation file and talking points
Meeting reports and follow-up plan
details.audience: Companies, investors and organisations whose projects depend on permits, concessions or public arbitration.

offerings.title: Private diplomacy
offerings.desc: Support in bilateral negotiations, influence missions and mandates with an international dimension.

details.intro: Some conversations cannot happen in the open. Marabu acts as a trusted third party: we prepare the ground, carry the messages and secure the framework through to agreement.
includes: Analysis of the political context and balance of power
Preparation and facilitation of bilateral negotiations
Influence missions and representation under mandate
Mediation and handling of sensitive disagreements
Strict confidentiality and secure communications
deliverables: Context note and negotiation strategy
Written mandate, with scope and confidentiality rules
Confidential reports and stage-by-stage recommendations
details.audience: Executives, private groups and institutions engaged in international or politically sensitive matters.

offerings.title: PTF partnerships
offerings.desc: Networking and facilitation with Technical and Financial Partners: donors, development agencies, embassies.

details.intro: Technical and financial partners have their own formats, calendars and criteria. We connect you to the right windows and align your file with their requirements.
includes: Identification of donors and funding windows suited to your project
Introductions to development agencies, embassies and funds
Structuring of the funding file and financial arrangement
Support through committees and due diligence
Management of the partner relationship after disbursement
deliverables: Map of accessible funding and calendar of calls
Funding file structured to the donor's standards
Relationship and reporting follow-up plan
details.audience: Public and private project owners, NGOs and local authorities seeking international funding.

offerings.title: Influence strategy
offerings.desc: Building influence positioning, interest advocacy, mapping of key actors and management of power relations.

details.intro: Influence is built before you have a case to defend. We identify the players who weigh on your issues, define your positions, and establish your voice where decisions are shaped.
includes: Mapping of key players and decision venues
Positioning and substantive messaging
Presence plan: bodies, forums, publications, networks
Interest representation and support in public consultations
Monitoring and measurement of shifts in the balance of power
deliverables: Influence map and analysis of the balance of power
Position platform and arguments by topic
Influence action plan, with milestones and indicators
details.audience: Trade bodies, private groups and institutions whose activity depends on public decisions or sector standards.

methode.title: How we work
methode.desc: Every mandate is unique. Our process adapts to your constraints, but always rests on the same foundations: listening, rigour, impact.

steps.title: Listening & diagnosis
steps.desc: Before any recommendation, we take the time to understand your real challenges. An in-depth consultation to grasp the context, constraints and ambitions.

steps.title: Designing the framework
steps.desc: We design a tailor-made response — no generic formulas. Each mission is built around your specific objectives.

steps.title: Implementation & steering
steps.desc: Rigorous execution with regular follow-up. We remain present throughout the mission to adjust in real time.

steps.title: Assessment & impact
steps.desc: Impact measurement, clear reporting of results and recommendations for the next steps. We measure our success by yours.
